subject: Post-demo compliance alignment and evidence action plan
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ledgeredge.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@fi-infra.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo compliance alignment and evidence action plan

Hi Samir / Marta —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so we have a single plan to move the SOC 2 / retention / DPA conversation forward.

Key pain points you flagged
- Audit log retention windows (current platform exports 90 days, compliance wants up to 2 years for some trails)
- DPA contract clauses and acceptable data residency language for EU customers
- Pen test cadence / scope and whether Redwood-provided infra artifacts are sufficient
- Ability to produce system/config screenshots and exported evidence on a sprint cadence

Goals we agreed on
- Confirm LedgerEdge acceptance criteria for SOC 2 evidence by Jan 26
- Provide an evidence package (artifact list + sample exports) for initial review by Jan 29
- Align on pen test window and vendor by Feb 12 so testing can start in Q2

What Redwood will deliver (next 7 business days)
1) Evidence checklist mapped to SOC 2 controls (attached: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf)
2) Audit-log extraction examples and retention configuration options (we can provide 90 / 365 / custom retention exports)
3) DPA standard clause language and an internal legal contact for redlines
4) Pen-test guidance: what infra artifacts we can provide (network diagrams, runbooks, ACL exports) and a proposed window

Requests for LedgerEdge (please confirm)
- Confirm the maximum retention window you need for ledger/audit events (90 / 365 / 730 days) and whether partial artifacts (metadata-only) are acceptable for older records
- Share the name/email of your procurement/legal contact for DPA redlines
- Attach any vendor-specific pen-test requirements or a sample scope (if you have a preferred tester)
- Send over your SOC 2 scoping workbook if available (we can map our artifacts directly)

Proposed next call: Jan 22 at 10:00 AM PT to review the evidence checklist and owners — will you both be available?

I attached the checklist referenced above. I copied Rachel (product security) and Karthik (infrastructure) to own evidence collection and retention config options.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147
[Attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF)]
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ledgeredge.com>

Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@fi-infra.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 18:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance alignment and evidence action plan

Grace — thanks for the clear summary, this matches our notes. A few clarifications and a first upload: 

Clarifications
- Retention: for financial audit trails we need 24 months (730 days) of event-level retention; aggregated summaries can be shorter.
- DPA/legal: loop is me + Marta (I handle product compliance; Marta is procurement/legal contact)
- Pen test: we prefer an external vendor (we have an approved list) and will share scope — the vendor wants "full system access simulation" with redacted PII in test data.

Attached: LE-SOC2-scope.xlsx — it's our internal scoping matrix, includes which controls we consider in-scope and a priority column.

We can make the Jan 22 10 AM PT call — that's fine.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product Compliance | LedgerEdge Inc.
samir.patel@ledgeredge.com | +1 212-555-0199
[Attachment: LE-SOC2-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

- Karthik: infra exports — can you produce a sample audit-log export for a 365-day and 730-day window and confirm size/format? Also confirm whether we can provide metadata-only exports for older records (Target: samples by Wed Jan 21 6 PM PT)
- Grace (me): DPA + pen test coordination — I'll share our standard DPA language and proposed pen-test artifact list with Samir + Marta in the next email and book the Jan 22 call.

Notes / risks
- Pen-test timing: LedgerEdge expects a full-scope vendor; we need to confirm which artifacts they will accept in lieu of direct access for sensitive environments.
- Retention storage cost: providing a 730-day export may require a short run-rate estimate — flagging for finance if LedgerEdge requires a long-term retention bucket.
